document_status: Revised research draft; not a proof-assistant formalization or peer-review certification.

claims.basis: Free-group certificates using retained equations only; independent slot-remapping and semantic checks.

claims.comparison_class: Closure of finite matrix-tracial channels with Choi support contained in the exact target support.

claims.statement: Lower bound 1/2 for channels with separate identity and j references.
claims.comparison_class: Same support-restricted comparison class and its closure.
claims.basis: Written two-reference input/output argument; scalar probe matrices checked.

claims.statement: For Phi_ref, Delta_J >= e0^2/65188028416 and Delta_diamond >= e0^2/1478656.

claims.basis: Written quantitative extraction proofs. Scalar constants checked, analytical proof not formalized.
